mapper.select: SELECT r.role_code FROM user_role ur INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 1 AND r.is_delete = 0 ORDER BY r.sort_order ASC, r.id ASC
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM user_role ur INNER JOIN `user` u ON u.id = ur.user_id INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE r.role_code = #{roleCode} AND u.is_delete = 0 AND r.is_delete = 0
